description: Date / Time Picker widget. Date-only values are calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD, no timezone); datetime values are local wall time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, no Z). Defaults apply once; clearing stays empty.

defaultValue.description: Default ISO date string. Applies once on first load; clearing stays empty (use Reset method to re-apply).

dateFormat.description: Documented display preference (rendered via locale display); input accepts YYYY-MM-DD.

minDate.description: Minimum selectable ISO date (inclusive, enforced for calendar/typed/time/method routes).

maxDate.description: Maximum selectable ISO date (inclusive, enforced for calendar/typed/time/method routes).

disabledDates.description: Disabled calendar dates as YYYY-MM-DD strings (aria-disabled, non-clickable, rejected on typed/method routes).

required.description: Required: empty value blocks form submit and shows an error.

readOnly.description: Read-only: focusable but not editable (distinct from disabled which blocks all routes).

isLoading.description: Loading overlay — boolean or template expression (e.g. {{ state.queries.q.isLoading }}).
